description: Election Commission - Mr. R. M. B. K. Senevirathne of the Udunuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Udunuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party (United People's Freedom Alliance). This falls under electoral processes and local government election matters, specifically addressing the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette.
